column1: # The previous GAZ-2975 photograph showed a police Tigr: grey with blue
# stripes, blue lights and police plates. A tester read the placement question
# through the livery and answered "military police". The card is about the
# army vehicle, so the photograph now shows one — in camouflage, from the front
# quarter, with a gunner at the roof ring, which is the fourth cue on the card
# and could not be seen at all in the old head-on shot.
